subject: Request: Senior approval for >20% Hosted API rate exception — WellnessAI strategic pilot
messages:
From: Claire Jensen <claire.j@wellnessai.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: WellnessAI Procurement <procurement@wellnessai.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing for strategic pilot — request for concession

Hi Sofia and Redwood team,

Thanks again for the demo last week. WellnessAI is preparing a pilot to replace our existing prompt infra — it would route ~18M tokens/month to Redwood (mixed generate + embeddings) for 12 months. Procurement asked me to check whether Redwood can support a deeper strategic pilot discount: target is 28% off list for Hosted API usage (we're proposing monthly usage billing).

We can commit to a 12-month pilot and a roadmap to expand to multi-region next year if performance and costs align. Procurement has a tight window — they want pricing and a draft MSA by the end of next week to hit their Q3 board review.

Attached: WellnessAI_MSA_v1.pdf and a high-level forecast (wellnessai-usage-forecast.xlsx).

Can you let me know whether this is feasible and what approvals you would need? Happy to jump on a quick call.

Best,
Claire
Claire Jensen
Head of Platform Partnerships
WellnessAI

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.j@wellnessai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing for strategic pilot — request for concession

Hi Claire — thanks for the context and the attachments. We like the product roadmap you outlined and the potential for a larger rollout. Two quick items before I escalate internally for a senior pricing exception:

- Can you confirm the committed tokens are 18M/month (and whether that is steady-state or ramping over the 12 months)?
- Will WellnessAI consider a prepay structure (partial up-front) in exchange for deeper discounts? That materially affects approval thresholds.

I will route this to Sales Ops and the deal desk. To be transparent: discounts >20% need senior sign-off (VP/Senior Exec) and we typically attach conditions (prepay, SLA, onboarding credits, and a DPA). If you’re open to those guardrails I’ll push a recommendation forward.

Suggested next step: a 30-min sync with Ben (cc’d) and our commercial ops to confirm volumes and finalize the deal economics. Are you available tomorrow morning PT?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: WellnessAI pricing — recommendation (need senior sign-off)

Mina — forwarding WellnessAI request. Quick summary / recommendation below: 

Context:
- Customer: WellnessAI (Strategic pilot; target: 18M tokens/month, 12 months)
- Current ask: 28% off list for Hosted API usage
- Revenue profile: estimated ARR equivalent ~$280k/year at list; ~217k/year at 22% discount (net).

Commercial implications:
- 28% would be a significant margin hit given expected support and onboarding.
- We can mitigate with compression: require 3-month partial prepay (first 3 months), include one-time onboarding credit (up to $5k) and require standard DPA + usage SLAs.

Recommendation (deal desk): approve a 22% sustained discount for 12 months under the following conditions:
- Customer signs the MSA (attached) + DPA
- Prepay of first 3 months (applied to monthly invoices)
- Inclusion of performance SLA; Redwood retains right to revert to list pricing if usage materially deviates (>30% over forecast) without renegotiation
- HubSpot deal ID: DL-2027-0842

Attachments: deal-econ-deck.pdf (short econ summary).

Asks: Mina — can you sign off on a 22% concession? If you prefer a different threshold I can propose alternative mitigations (shorter term, higher onboarding fee). We need a decision by Wed 28 Jul to meet WellnessAI procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Ben
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
